text:
devon: Quick review ping for PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/482 — migration to compact event_logs and updated pipeline to ingest new shard layout. Looking for DB + data pipeline review and timing for prod roll.

sara: I'll take a look in a bit, adding to my queue :eyes:

marcus: skimmed — question: the migration does a table rewrite. Is that an ALTER ... USING full rewrite? can we chunk it to avoid long exclusive locks?

devon: good call. the migration is:
```
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE event_logs ADD COLUMN compacted BOOL DEFAULT false;
UPDATE event_logs SET compacted = true WHERE created_at < now() - interval '90 days';
-- followed by CTAS to create compacted_events and swap
COMMIT;
```
It will rewrite rows > 90d. Thinking to run in batches but wanted feedback on approach.

olivia: left inline comment on the PR about batching (50k rows per tx) and vacuum tuning. also asked to add a metrics counter for migration progress.

khalid: pinging @db-team — we need schema-owner signoff for any table rewrite. also note pipelines ingester-consumer will need to handle the new compacted_events topic name.

db-bot: Automated check: PR 482 migration touches event_logs, flags potential full-table rewrite. Recommend submitting migration plan doc and scheduling in migration window.

sara: I ran a quick estimate on staging. For 120M rows, full rewrite ~ 4h on r6.large. If we batch 50k per tx it was ~6h but with low lock time. My suggestion: backfill as background job and perform CTAS swap in small maintenance window.

devon: thanks — I'll update the PR with batching and a rollback step. Can someone from infra do a quick perf run on staging tomorrow? ideally before EOD.

marcus: I can run the perf test tomorrow morning. If olivia + sara are ok with the changes we can mark for canary deploy and then schedule prod during the 03/23 migration window.

olivia: LGTM after the batching + metrics, will approve once updated.

devon: updated PR with batching + metrics and added migration plan link: https://docs.internal.redwood/migrations/482. Marking for review again.

migrations-bot: Migration 482 scheduled for canary on staging at 2026-03-21T09:00:00Z, prod tentative 2026-03-23T02:00:00Z (awaiting approvals).

sara: approved.

marcus: leaving final +1. devon — please coordinate with oncall before the prod swap.

devon: will do, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
